hypothesis: A capped poll rebuilds and checks every held record even after its delivery cap is met. Per-partition VecDeque queues plus compact contiguous-run order metadata allow capped polls to inspect arrival-run heads, skip held paused runs and stop at the cap while preserving global arrival order.

acceptance_met: Corrected harness landed independently on main before measurements. Exact pinned corrected baseline is measured first and proves the card's real 100k paused-backlog workload. Original inaccurate fixture data is retained and explicitly excluded.

Deterministic acceptance: allocations per capped poll fall 20.13%, exceeding 5%, with identical counts in all five A/B repetitions. CPU per poll also falls 99.66%, with paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; local wall throughput improves by well over 3%.

Named-cell CPU and both RSS measures improve. Supplemental bulk CPU/allocation/throughput guards pass on all 25 medians and1000p guards pass on five medians. Exact client RUSAGE_SELF maximum is unchanged and final10-pair VmHWM corroborates it in every run; no authoritative peak guard regresses2%. Prior coarse10ms peak estimates that rose8.393%/16.934% remain explicitly visible and are not labelled passing.

Capped polls stop at the delivery cap and inspect compact arrival runs rather than cloning/hashing/rebuilding every retained record. Per-partition queues release when emptied or dropped; no pool, new dependency, unsafe code, public API or default change.
Exact global arrival order is retained even when older paused records resume after a later Fetch round. Tests pin independent pause/resume/seek byte accounting and delivered-offset commits.
All listed correctness suites pass, with the single pre-existing ignored live-broker test and no new skips. Net production addition 109 lines; no allocation/instruction budget raised.
limits: Local/unsigned exploratory null-broker optimization evidence; no Kafka throughput comparison or public performance claim. Suite HOLD remains active.
The named cell uses synthetic uncompressed read_uncommitted records; committed offsets, seek, pause/resume and assignment retention are correctness-tested rather than additional performance cells.

Capped polls still inspect arrival-run metadata for paused runs. A workload with very many alternating short runs may cost more than the six contiguous partition queues measured here; retained records themselves are not rescanned.
RSS sampler uses10 ms intervals; whole-process RUSAGE peak supplements it and can include setup/artifact work. Both independent RSS metrics improve.
Most candidate capped drains take below 1µs, so the harness quantizes their reported p99 to 0µs. This is a resolution limit and is not a zero-latency claim.

Client and broker are pinnedCPU3, but host CPU frequency is unmanaged and other workers may build on different affinity CPUs within the shared 4-core cgroup quota. Deterministic allocation counts provide the acceptance route.
Original incorrect20k active-only measurement remains archived as historical/excluded data. It must not be merged into the corrected-cell paired statistics.

Supplemental bulk/1000p single-round timing guards have broad paired CIs; median changes meet2% but cannot statistically exclude all2% regressions. They exercise unchanged uncapped fast paths; deterministic allocation/byte counts are identical.

Original5 and first10 additional bulk cohorts show +8.393% and +16.934% coarse10ms sampled peak estimates. These estimates remain reported as exceeding2%, not passing. Verified direct client maximum resident memory is authoritative after explicit method review: RUSAGE_SELF and persistent VmHWM agree within 0.2% in20runs.

Observer covers runtime lifetime, while internal selfpeak is read at phase end; one baseline lifetime peak is0.186% higher from later allocation. External wait4 covers rustc provenance descendant~85.2MB and is excluded from client self guardrail using retained controlled probes.
External smaps_rollup current RSS can exceed kernel resident counters slightly due Linux RSS accounting; persistent VmHWM is compared to RUSAGE_SELF rather than instantaneous sample max.

Final evidence preserves initial named five pairs, first supplemental five pairs, first10 smaps-only pairs and final10 VmHWM pairs separately; no outcome was replaced. Observer overhead exists in last20 bulk pairs only and is stated in aggregate provenance.
